missing_structure_debts.debt: A scalar codomain plus a role-defining construction would be additional structure, not a repair allowed inside S0.
Coupling the group involution to the direction cover requires explicit coherence axioms; equality is not free.
A scalar angular normalization is an additional readout and cannot be inferred from the unnormalized cover.

results.proof: Typing is syntactic before semantics: a term cannot have a codomain sort absent from the signature. Encoding an incidence configuration by an external number would be an added N2 readout, not an S0 term.
results.statement: No scalar-valued pi-role formula is well-typed in S0 because its signature contains no scalar/codomain sort and no definable scalarization operator.

results.proof: All primitives are incidence/cell/orientation data. Finite counts can be formed only in an external/meta or declared readout layer; no native scalar field or angular scalarization is present.
results.statement: S1 supports finite cyclic/permutation roles but not a native geometric scalar role.

results.proof: The S2 axioms specify field/vector/torsor laws only and contain no role predicate distinguishing a scalar by metric, turning, valuation, spectral, or refinement behavior. Any claim of a distinguished extra scalar therefore has a dependency not present in S2; when K has nontrivial automorphisms, parameter-free candidates must additionally be fixed by them.
results.statement: Adding a scalar field sort does not by itself select a pi-role scalar.

results.proof: S3 contains no axiom relating rho(z) to q. A finite explicit countermodel is frozen in R052_MODEL_COUNTEREXAMPLES.json: rho(z) permutes UDir fibers while delta_q swaps the two elements inside each fixed fiber.
results.statement: The unique deck involution delta_q and the action rho(z) of the unique group involution are both well-typed and unique but are not forced equal by S3.

results.proof: For every positive c, replacing mu by c*mu preserves all coarser S4+N data and sends every ratio Per_N(C)^2/mu(C) to its old value divided by c; the infimum cut scales by the same factor.
results.statement: The raw isoperimetric role is not determined by the normed-affine reduct when valuation normalization is forgotten.

results.proof: An infinite cyclic group has exactly two generators t and t^{-1}. Because the signature marks neither orientation nor one generator, inversion preserves the declared structure while exchanging them. Only their inversion orbit can be invariant.
results.statement: A raw generator of ker(p) is not a canonical role object.

results.proof: The family contains S0 and S1 models in which a scalar role is not even well-typed, S3 models with two distinct well-typed permutation roles, and S5 expansions whose scalar role changes under valuation rescaling of a common weaker reduct.
results.statement: No single scalar-valued universal pi-role follows from the entire frozen weak-plane family.
